Chandigarh grants freehold rights to 50,000 rehabilitation colony households

In what is being described as a "poll season bonanza," Chandigarh has announced freehold rights for approximately 50,000 households residing in rehabilitation colonies. This decision, announced by Kataria, grants eligible residents ownership rights to their properties.
